reviews.review_title: Careful during open box delivery. Check damages & dents
reviews.review_comment: About Inspection - Important Note for Black Glass Model Since the refrigerator has a black glossy finish, scratches or dents are very hard to spot, and the protective plastic film makes it even harder to detect damage during open-box delivery. Do not share the otp for delivery until inspection completes and you're satisfied. Please follow this method to check: 1. Always position the fridge so that light falls from the side (left or right) before you start the inspection. Side light makes scratches and dents easily visible. 2. First ask the delivery executive if you are allowed to remove the protective plastic film. 3. After removing, check the surface by looking at your own reflection. Move slowly and see if the reflection moves smoothly. If the reflection suddenly blurs, waves, or glides unevenly, there is a dent/bump there. 4. If you find any damage, record it with a photo and video. Minor scratches and dents on a glossy black surface are very difficult to capture in a photo, so video is better. 5. If you see the scratches or dent, reject the delivery. Product Review 1. No light in the freezer compartment. 2. The freezer door does not close smoothly I will update the review after 2 months of usage
